question: Scenario: A Citrix Engineer is performing a health check of the NetScaler Web App Firewall. The engineer notes that the /var file system is nearing capacity. What can the engineer do to reduce use of the /var file system while maintaining good security? A. Disable the Learn action on all NetScaler Web App Firewall profiles. B. Create a syslog action to send NetScaler Web App Firewall logs to a syslog server. C. Create a NetScaler Web App Firewall Audit policy to redirect log file entries to a syslog server. D. Disable the Log action on all NetScaler Web App Firewall profiles.

Scenario: A Citrix Engineer needs to ensure a steady, consistent flow of traffic to a web application that will NOT overwhelm the server. After thorough testing, the engineer determines that the application can handle a maximum of 3,000 requests per minute. When configuring rate limiting, the engineer should define a time slice of ______, a threshold of ______, and a limit type of _______. A. 60; 3,000; BURSTY B. 60; 3,000; SMOOTH C. 200; 10; SMOOTH D. 200;10; BURSTY

A Citrix Engineer wants to set up NetScaler Web App Firewall protection for a critical web application and decides to use the Learn function to quickly add relaxation rules. Which three protections support the Learn action? (Choose three.) A. From Field Consistency B. Cross-Site Request Forgeries (CSRF) C. Buffer Overflow D. Start URL E. Deny URL

A Citrix Engineer for a college wants to ensure that no Social Security numbers are accidentally leaked from the student portal. Which set of steps should the engineer take to protect the environment against this activity? A. Check Safe Object in the NetScaler Web App Firewall profile under Relaxation Rules and click Edit. The add a rule and click Create. B. Click Additional Rules in the NetScaler Web App Firewall profile under Credit Card. Then add a rule and click Create. C. Check Credit Card in the NetScaler Web App Firewall under Actions and click Edit. Then add a custom rule and click Create. D. Check Safe Object in the NetScaler Web App Firewall policy under Actions and click Edit. Then add a rule and click Create.

Scenario: A Citrix Engineer has enabled the IP Reputation feature. The engineer wants to protect a critical we application from a distributed denial of service attack. Which advanced expression can the engineer write for a Responder policy? A. CLIENT.IP.SRC.IPREP_THREAT_CATEGORY(BOTNETS) B. CLIENT.IP.SRC.IPREP_THREAT_CATEGORY (SPAM_SOURCES) C. CLIENT.IP.SRC.IPREP_THREAT_CATEGORY(WEB_ATTACKS) D. CLIENT.IP.SRC.IPREP_THREAT_CATEGORY(WINDOWS_EXPLOITS)
